verdict.rationale: The models page documents exact context length (64k tokens per request, with precise accounting of state+questions), per-model listing via GET /v1/models, and Usage interface reporting exact input token counts — this is precise, non-marketing documentation of context/token budgets per model, not vague ranges. missing for 10: no explicit separate 'max output tokens' limit is documented (output tokens are described as free/uncapped rather than given an explicit output budget number), and no independent/community corroboration of the stated context figures.
